samples.title: Giờ làm linh hoạt
samples.prompt: Your friend is interested in flexible working hours but does not know where to begin. Write an email giving practical advice, explaining a possible difficulty, and offering help.

samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for telling me about your interest in flexible working hours. I understand why you are unsure where to start. You do not need a perfect plan immediately, but a few practical steps could make things easier.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng cảm, xác định mục đích khuyên.

paragraphs.label: Lời khuyên đầu
paragraphs.text: First, I suggest joining a flexible working discussion at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. There, we can compare working schedules and plan shared team hours. One useful point is that employees can organise work around practical personal needs. For example, a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school.
paragraphs.noteVi: Gợi ý hoạt động có ngày, nơi và lý do.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và cách xử lý
paragraphs.text: One thing to remember is that team members may not be available at the same time. This can happen because flexible schedules may be introduced without agreed shared hours. A useful response would be to set core hours and make availability clear to the team. For instance, a department could agree that everyone is reachable between ten and three while allowing choice outside that period. Try the idea on a small scale before deciding whether to continue.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu giới hạn để lời khuyên không tuyệt đối.

paragraphs.label: Đề nghị và kết
paragraphs.text:
If you like, I can come with you and help you write down the most useful points. Afterwards, we could make a simple plan together.

Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
